title: Context compression resets patch_file read-state; files read before summary window require re-read
description: When the conversation is summarized due to context window limits, the moeb harness's file-read tracking is reset. Files that were read via read_file in the pre-compression portion of a run are no longer recognized as having been read, causing patch_file to reject write operations with 'exists on disk but has not been read during this run'. The agent must call read_file again for any file it needs to patch after context compression. This produces ToolHandler errors recorded in RunState.tool_errors and causes the tool-errors rubric to fail. Observed during the rubric-layer-placement-cleanup spec run (run_id 13bb9697-4874-43e5-bd20-cafade30047d): signals/index.md was read in the pre-compression session but rejected by patch_file after resumption.
proposed_resolution: Either (1) persist the file-read tracking across session context resets by writing read file paths to the run state file and reloading them on session resume, or (2) update patch_file to accept writes to files whose content was captured in the summarized conversation history. As a short-term mitigation, skill instructions should note that after context compression any file targeted by patch_file must be re-read via read_file before patching.
